title: Biocatalytic cascade combining an engineered pyranose 2-oxidase and transaminases for the synthesis of amino sugars
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,32600-32608
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04556H, Paper

Litavadee Chuaboon, Surawit Visitsatthawong, Orawan Sookbampen, Siripakorn Suthin, Moritz Voss, Thanyaporn Wongnate, Matthias Höhne, Uwe T. Bornscheuer, Pimchai Chaiyen
C2 chiral amino sugars are important synthons in various fields. By combining reactions of a pyranose 2-oxidase and transaminases, the catalytic cascades for synthesizing rare amino sugars mannosamine, glucosamine, and galactosamine were achieved.
